## **Testing (stories):**

* Slider on light background - light nodes - naviagtion top - has scrollbar 
* slider on light background - dark nodes - navigation bottom - has scrollbar 
* slider on dark background - dark nodes - navigation hidden - no scrollbar 
* slider on bright background - light nodes - navigation bottom - has scrollbar - has action button

## **Technical details**:

_**organism/InpageNavigationCompactSlider**_

```
const InpageNavigationCompactSlider {
  colorMode: 'on-light' | 'on-dark' | 'on-bright';
  
  categoryNodesBig : categoryNodeBigProps[];
  
  header? : string;
  
  subline? : string;
  
  navigationPosition? : 'top' | 'bottom'
  
  hasScrollbar? : boolean;
  
  cta? : {
    text : string;
    link : string;
    variant : ButtonVariants
  }
}
```

‌

* if a CTA added the navigation position will be on bottom by default 
* please use `LuiCommonSwipper` for slider 
* do not use fixed css values for slides use slider options 
* do not pass colorMode to the nodes because it has it's own modes based on the background
* hide navigation arrow if all the nodes are available
* components will be used `LuiText` ,`LuiButton`, `CategoryNodeBasic`,`LuiCommonSwipper` , `LuiSwiperNavigationCompact` , `LuiSwipperScrollbar`
summary: High-impact horizontal slider for large category nodes with independent color modes and configurable navigation.

Navigation position options: top or bottom

Independent color mode per node based on image contrast
longDescription:
## Purpose

The InpageNavigationBigSlider component provides a high-impact horizontal slider for displaying large category nodes, ideal for hero sections and prominent homepage placements. It combines visual impact with smooth slider navigation for browsing featured categories.

## Use Cases

- Create hero-style category carousels on store homepages
- Display featured category collections with high-impact imagery
- Mix different node formats (square, landscape, portrait) in a single slider
- Add promotional badges to highlight sale or new categories
- Include optional CTA buttons for directing users to category overviews

## Design Rationale

The slider does not propagate its colorMode to child nodes; each CategoryNodeBig determines its own color mode based on its image contrast requirements. This ensures optimal text readability across nodes with diverse imagery. Navigation visibility adapts automatically: controls hide when all nodes fit on screen to reduce visual clutter. CTA buttons automatically position navigation to the bottom for balanced visual layout.
shortDescription: Ideal for hero sections and prominent homepage placements. Does not propagate colorMode to child nodes - each CategoryNodeBig determines its own color mode based on image contrast. Supports promotional badges and optional CTA buttons with selectable variants. Uses LuiCommonSwiper for smooth navigation with optional scrollbar display.
